duration.text: The Philosophy at China University of Petroleum (Huadong) is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7.Photocopies of parents' passport or identification documents(Optional) For example, photocopy of ID card, photocopy of passport, etc.
